name: Until Time Runs Out
source:
You are placed on a ship with nine suspicious characters.
One by one, the people on the ship start to die.
The goal is simple. Catch the killer before everyone gets killed.
But can you even survive to gather enough clues? Be aware, it is possible to die.
Surviving is easy, but the riddle won't be solved until the killer is caught.
Everything might not make sense, until the killer reveals the whole story.

[From [url=http://kream-cheese.deviantart.com/art/VN-Game-Until-Time-Runs-Out-276940587]official site[/url]]
translation:
你被安置在一艘船上，船上有九个可疑人物。
船上的人一一开始死亡。
目标很简单。在所有人都被杀之前抓住凶手。
但你能活下来收集足够的线索吗？请注意，死亡是可能的。
生存很容易，但只有抓到凶手，谜题才能解开。
在凶手揭露整个故事之前，一切可能都没有意义。

[来自[url=http://kream-cheese.deviantart.com/art/VN-Game-Until-Time-Runs-Out-276940587]官方网站[/url]]
